docs: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs). Making one: create the doc first, then fill it.
docx: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx). Triggers include any mention of Word documents or a request to produce a professional document deliverable.
technical-writer: General technical writing assistant: write documentation, specs, READMEs, guides and explanations for any software or product. Use for any documentation-writing request.
